_spec: SNG-656 (Aevi 2026-09-25): how each power's anonymous raiders COME — `comes: quiet | loud | mixed`, CCode's field name (CCODE-509: name the fact, not the mechanic). Power-level default; a contingent may carry its own. The named leader is read as a person and needs no word.

power_switchback_tollmen._comesWhy: crossbows from the rocks — they wait, then they are loud

power_edge_riders._comesWhy: churn-bred horses come fast out of nowhere; you hear them late, then very much

power_undercount._comesWhy: burglars, knives and lookouts, never in one place — the definition of quiet

power_flesh_temple._comesWhy: adepts whose bodies are disciplined enough to be quiet when they choose

power_vacated_custody._comesWhy: porters who move bodies nobody is using; nobody notices a porter

power_grovehome_moot._comesWhy: slow to muster and easy to see coming — but in the Greenward they are the wood

power_long_choir._comesWhy: singers further away than they look: you hear them, and you are wrong about where

power_cairnhold_wardens._comesWhy: march-wardens move unseen on the moor; the grave-crews do not

power_harvest_hand._comesWhy: the reapers come for what is ready, and the ready do not hear them

power_the_scouring._comesWhy: unmakers; some come as a crew, some come as an absence

power_hollow_court._comesWhy: court wardens keep every term — including the ones about when to be seen

power_harborward._comesWhy: Umbral keepers; the dark is where they live

power_deepwood_moot._comesWhy: an Ent standing still is a hill; an Ent moving is not quiet at all

1._comesWhy: the slip-wardens fight from the boats and come in under the harbour noise
